pages.raw_meta: Stay on top of routine upkeep. Easily schedule home care and maintenance projects to keep your home looking fresh and running smoothly year-round.
raw_blocks: Find trusted pros and fair pricing for any home project — and get the job done right, guaranteed.
Whether you know us as Angie's List or Angi, our dedication is the same: helping people love where they live.
Tell us what your home needs!
From routine maintenance and repairs to dream home renovations, we can help with any project — big or small.
Book home services in an instant.
Get the help you need — when you need it — with upfront pricing and instant booking for plumbing, cleaning and more.
Stay on top of routine upkeep.
Easily schedule home care and maintenance projects to keep your home looking fresh and running smoothly year-round.
Bring your dream home to life.
Find information and inspiration to kick-start bigger home projects — and connect with trusted pros to bring your visions to life.
We'll match you with personalized solutions
See your price and book services in an instant. Or, request and compare quotes from highly rated pros near you.
We screen Angi Approved pros to ensure that we're connecting you with qualified home service professionals.
See what your neighbors think about pros before you hire. We verify that each review is coming from a real pro customer.
Pros for projects big and small
With thousands of skilled pros in 500+ categories, we can connect you with the right pro for any home project.
Start to finish, we’ve got you covered
We’ve got your back with fair and transparent pricing, on-call service support, and our Happiness Guarantee.
We’ve collected cost data from millions of real home projects to be sure you’re getting fair, upfront pricing for yours.
Reach out for help anytime. Our customer support team is standing by to assist you every step of the way.
When you book and pay with Angi you’re covered by our Happiness Guarantee. We’ll cover your project up to the full purchase price, plus limited damage protection.

Angie’s List is now Angi. You’ll still find the same highly rated pros, deals, and verified neighbor reviews you’ve counted on for more than 20 years. Only now, you’ll also get access to instant booking, upfront pricing, project financing, and more to make caring for your home even easier.

Yes. You can use Angi and the Angi app to book home services, request project quotes, and research local pros and pricing, all for free. Our revenue comes from two sources: service professionals, who pay to advertise services and discount offers on Angi, and paid memberships, which give homeowners access to discounted home services and more for an annual fee.

To become Angi Approved — and pay to advertise services and discounts on Angi — businesses with at least one review are required to maintain an average rating of 3 stars or higher. The business’s owner, principal, or relevant manager must pass a criminal background check, and the business must maintain all applicable state and local licenses. We revoke the approval and advertising of any business that fails to maintain these requirements.

We’ve done our homework to ensure you’re presented with fair service pricing and accurate local cost information. See transparent pricing and book home services in an instant. Or, search member pricing guides to see what your neighbors paid for hundreds of different home projects. You can rest assured that all of the pricing you see on Angi is based on data collected from millions of real home projects, provided by real homeowners like you. When you’re requesting quotes and working directly with pros on your projects, we recommend that you get at least three quotes and pay close attention to bids and contracts. If something is unclear, be sure to ask questions and get clarification. You can find more about quotes and contracts here .
To reach Angi service support, call 888-811-ANGI.
